h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Adoni

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Adoni

items.pText: Adoni is a cotton trading town in Kurnool district, and its schools and residential layouts deal with long, dry summers on hard, rocky ground. FunPlay Systems is a playground equipment manufacturer that supplies Adoni from our factory in Vasai, about 620 km away. We make swings, slides, climbers and multi play systems in-house, send them by road and install them with our own team or a dealer in the region.

Most enquiries from a town like Adoni come from school managements, layout developers and community trusts setting up a small park. Each of them wants equipment that copes with the heat and needs little attention. Our posts are galvanised steel and our slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic. Both are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant, which matters when one piece faces a scorching April and a wet September. Send us a photo of your ground and we will tell you whether grouting or a self-standing base suits it.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning shade and sun direction for an Adoni playground

c: In Rayalaseema the sun is the main thing to plan around. Where you can, turn slides so the sliding surface faces away from the afternoon sun, and place swings where a building or a row of trees throws shade after lunch. Lighter colours from our 15+ roto-moulded shades stay more comfortable to touch than dark ones.

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on rocky ground in Adoni?
items.a: Yes. On hard or rocky ground we usually grout the posts into a concrete base. Where the surface is already paved and level, some pieces can stand on their own. We decide this from your site photos.

items.q: Which colours are best for a sunny playground?
items.a: Lighter shades such as yellows, light blues and greens heat up less than dark colours in direct sun. We offer 15+ roto-moulded shades, so you can pick a combination that suits both the heat and your building.

items.q: What warranty comes with equipment sent to Adoni?
items.a: The same as everywhere in India. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry 3 years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, for manufacturing defects when installed and maintained as per our instructions.
